svg.text: THE BIT · THE ACT, EXACTLY THE SENTENCE
the minimal premise: necessary and sufficient, and every route to the sentence passes it
A CROSSING
a functional never rising along the step, level off the seat only where the step lands on it
A WITNESS · THE 2002 FUNCTIONAL'S SHAPE
strictly decreasing along the step at every state off the
seat, and invariant under the rescaling
PERELMAN'S DERIVATION
one inhabitant of the bit, accepted as unconditional on
18 March 2010
the route needs, beside the functional, the κ-solutions, the
canonical neighbourhoods, surgery and finite extinction: it
carries more than the sentence
the self-similar flow
the act holds, a crossing
exists, no witness exists
THE RECORD ACCEPTED THE INHABITANT; THE KERNEL PUTS THE INHABITANT INSIDE THE BIT
Whatever yields the sentence yields the bit, so to accept Perelman's derivation as resolving the question was to accept a delivery of the Poincaré bit. The bit stood at
premise grade in Lean before the award and stands there after it.
